caption: A car drives past an office building with a glass front, and the car's reflection glides across the windows.

sa.check: A car drives past an office building.
The car's reflection glides across the building's windows.
The building has a glass front.

pc.expect: The reflection moves in step with the car and appears only in the glass, jumping slightly at the frames between panes.
pc.fail: It stays still while the car moves; or continues across solid wall; or it is missing in plainly reflective glass.

pc.expect: The reflection is a mirror image of the car, same colours and size, with any lettering reversed.
pc.fail: It is a different vehicle or colour; or upside down; or its lettering reads the right way round.

pc.expect: Nothing moves in the reflection that is not moving in reality.
pc.fail: The reflection moves while the car has stopped; or shows the car heading a different way.

pc.expect: The panes are flat and rigid: the reflection is undistorted and the interior is seen through.
pc.fail: The glass ripples; or the reflection warps as it slides; or the frames bend.

pc.expect: One car and one reflection per pane.
pc.fail: A second car appears; or the car drives into the glass; or the reflection steps out; or the car vanishes.

pc.expect: The building, the car and the street stay the same.
pc.fail: The car changes colour; or the building's frames change; or the street rearranges.
